title: Find an EggCC bug or a measured speedup

questions.prompt: Must the successful case use injectivity and disequality together?
questions.description: The previous study used both but added no detection power or speedup. This choice determines whether a genuine payoff using only one encoding can close the stronger goal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Prefer both together, but allow either encoding if it exposes a genuine compiler bug or produces a measured speedup.

options.label: Require both in the successful case

questions.prompt: Which measured speedups can satisfy the goal?
questions.description: Select either or both. Compiler time means a matched end-to-end compilation workload; isolated rule timings or an optimization with no demonstrated performance benefit will not qualify.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Accept either faster generated programs or faster end-to-end compilation, with correct outputs and repeated matched measurements.
